Trans:
Referendums on joining the Russian Federation have begun for the Donetsk People's Republic (ДНР), Lugansk People's Republic (ЛНР), Kherson Oblast, and Zaporizhzhia Oblast. Residents who have left these territories can vote in Russia; polling stations are already operating in the Jewish Autonomous Oblast, on Kamchatka, and on Sakhalin.

The voting, which began today, will run from September 23 to September 27, 2022. Voting will take place over four days outside the precinct commission areas, i.e., on residential premises, and one day inside the precinct commission buildings for the referendum.

The referendum will be considered approved if more than half of the participants support it.
